description: ndv-diagnose cases for the composed-agent experiment: the 3 fleet cases plus 5 added here.

cases.input:
This test fails: `assert.equal(avg([1, 2, 3]), 2)` → actual: NaN.
Reproduce: `node --test test/avg.test.js`. Observed in CI and locally. Changed recently: someone "simplified" the loop last week.

```js
export function avg(xs) {
  let sum = 0
  for (let i = 0; i <= xs.length; i++) sum += xs[i]
  return sum / xs.length
}
```

checks.name: loop reads one past the end

cases.why: i <= length adds undefined, so the sum is NaN.
The root cause is SQL injection. Pierce names it and hands it to ndv-secure without writing the patch.
